Frequently asked questions

I am currently on a CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G or SE plan. Will I automatically get the new plan benefits?

No. To enjoy the latest benefits, you’ll need to switch to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plans.

I have supplementary lines under my account. If I change my principal line, do I need to change my supplementary lines too?

Yes. When you switch your principal line to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plan, all supplementary lines must also be moved to the new plan series.

You can choose any CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plan for each supplementary line — and enjoy discounted rates on supplementary lines, depending on your principal plan.

Example:

  • Principal line: CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 160 (2026)
  • Supplementary line 1: CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 190 (2026)
  • Supplementary line 2: CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 140 (2026)
  • Supplementary line 3: CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 60 SE (2026)
I’m on a device/service contract with my current Postpaid 5G plan. Can I still change to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plans?

Yes. You can switch to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plans. If you upgrade to a higher-value plan, your remaining contract tenure will continue with no early termination penalty.

Frequently asked questions
I am currently on a CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G or SE plan. Will I automatically get the new plan benefits?
No. To enjoy the latest benefits, you’ll need to switch to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plans.
I have supplementary lines under my account. If I change my principal line, do I need to change my supplementary lines too?
Yes. When you switch your principal line to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plan, all supplementary lines must also be moved to the new plan series.
You can choose any CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plan for each supplementary line — and enjoy discounted rates on supplementary lines, depending on your principal plan.
Example:
Principal line:
CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 160 (2026)
Supplementary line 1:
CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 190 (2026)
Supplementary line 2:
CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 140 (2026)
Supplementary line 3:
CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 60 SE (2026)
I’m on a device/service contract with my current Postpaid 5G plan. Can I still change to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plans?
Yes. You can switch to the all-new CelcomDigi Postpaid 5G 2026 plans. If you upgrade to a higher-value plan, your remaining contract tenure will continue with no early termination penalty.
